overall_topic.topic: Debate on Police Crackdowns and Civil Liberties regarding the CJP Tiranga Yatra
overall_topic.description: A televised debate focusing on the legality, police actions, and political reactions surrounding the detention of CJP protesters, contrasting government enforcement of law and order with constitutional rights to peaceful dissent.
